title: Power outages and melting roads: Heatwave strains French infrastructure
summary: Power outages, train delays, and melting roads - the heatwave is straining France's infrastructure. Electricity provider EDF says it has had to reduce its nuclear power output, but that it still has enough capacity to meet demand.
